## NSXL for Windows 1.1.1

Fixes for the quick menu and VPN settings.

- **Quick menu opens reliably.** It now opens from NSXL Home too, and reads your controller even when Windows won't hand it focus over a game.
- **Fixed Xbox button / View + Menu detection.** A memory bug in the controller reader could stop it silently; it also falls back to older XInput versions.
- **Backup keyboard shortcut.** If Ctrl+Alt+Space is taken, NSXL uses Ctrl+Shift+Space or Alt+F1.
- **Try the quick menu** in Settings › Controls shows the active shortcut and whether an Xbox-style controller was found. It's also in the Power menu.
- **VPN settings no longer flicker.** The page only updates when your PIA connection actually changes.

Download **NSXL-Setup** to install, or **NSXL-Portable** to run without installing.
